mission.brief: Create failed-sites.txt with sorted unique failed site names from checks.txt: beta then zeta. Create count.txt with their count (2 and LF), preserve checks.txt, display the successful four-stage selection result, and read both final reports after every write. Choose an equivalent supported approach.
constraints: Only simulated UTF-8 text. No host shell, files, processes or network.
Use Command reference for the exact supported subset; no regex, globbing, variables, escapes or unsupported options. Quotes group literal words.
Locale is C: bytewise sorting and ASCII word separators. wc -c counts UTF-8 bytes; wc -l counts LF characters.
Inspection goals require the named tool and exact displayed result from the relevant source; equivalent supported paths and approaches count.
Only declared report destinations may be written. > truncates before input is read; errors do not undo writes. >> appends.
Any actual write clears earlier verification. Finish changes before inspecting the final outputs. Final report grading does not require one exact transcript.

objectives.label: Final report: sorted unique failed sites
Inspection: display selected names via pipeline

hints: Separate changing reports from verifying them. Preserve the source, and check both content and count.
Count the deduplicated report, not every failed record. Avoid filename labels in the saved count by using pipeline stdin.
Build failed-sites.txt, then cat failed-sites.txt | wc -l > count.txt. Repeat the successful selection pipeline without redirection and read both reports.

lesson.goal: Create and verify a sorted failed-site report and its count; preserve the source.

steps.command: grep -F "|fail" checks.txt | cut -d "|" -f 1 | sort | uniq > failed-sites.txt
steps.explanation: Create the final unique-name report. Projection and sorting happen before deduplication.
Pipeline stdin avoids a filename label in wc output. Count the unique report records, not raw failed events.
The pinned source must remain unchanged; this is a final-state rule rather than a required transcript.
Demonstrate the final selection result visibly after writes. Internal or redirected output alone is not inspection evidence.
Read the final report after all mutations.
Verify the saved count, not just a plausible number in an earlier transcript.
